question: The 25th Amendment curtailed the right to property by amending which Article of Indian Constitution?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Article 31**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Article 31** originally dealt with the **right to property** under Part III of the **Indian Constitution**, which enumerates Fundamental Rights.
 
• The **25th Amendment Act, 1971** amended Article 31 to restrict the right to property and introduced changes to empower the state to acquire private property for public purposes.
 
• The amendment added a new provision, **Article 31C**, which stated that laws made to implement certain Directive Principles of State Policy mentioned under **Article 39(b) and (c)** cannot be challenged on the grounds of violation of Fundamental Rights.
 
• This amendment was aimed at ensuring that laws related to property acquisition for equitable distribution and public welfare were not hindered by claims of infringement of Fundamental Rights. H
